deploybot: Scheduling private rollout for MeridianHealth (Dedicated). Start: 2025-09-12 01:00 UTC. Canary: 6% -> 20% -> 100% with 20m windows. Model pinned: `rwinf-3.2.7-int8`. Runtime: `redwood/runtime:2025-08-15-f1`. KMS key: `projects/meridian/keys/mh-kms-5`. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% (5m) OR p95 > 550ms (5m). Ticket: RD-3399.
nina: Can we make first canary 10%? customer wants more variance for rerank checks.
lee: 10% ok but recommend `--warmup=45s` to mitigate kv-cache spikes. Also pin `net-agent:1.7.3`.
ops_lead: Ensure previous runtime `redwood/runtime:2025-07-01-c0` is warmed for rollback. Add runtime image to job template.
sre_oncall: Add short-circuit: if p95 > 480ms for 3m, autoscale to canary-burst and pause shift. Page at p95 > 700ms for 2m or 5xx > 1% for 2m.
security: MH-kms-5 rotation scheduled 2025-09-12 03:30 UTC 30 overlap. @client_eng can rotation be delayed +8h?
client_eng: Confirmed with customer ops: rotation can be moved to 2025-09-12 11:30 UTC. They'll expect an audit note in runbook.
nina: I'll update runbook and append rotation exception and manual rollback commands.
deploybot: Updated plan: first canary 10% -> 20% -> 100%. Example start: `rdw-deploy start --customer meridianhealth --model rwinf-3.2.7-int8 --canary 10 --steps 20,100 --window 20m --runtime redwood/runtime:2025-08-15-f1 --warmup 45s`. Logs: https://rdw.co/logs/meridian/1748123456
lee: Rollback snippet for runbook: `rdw-deploy rollback --customer meridianhealth --to rwinf-3.2.6` and `rdw-check state --customer meridianhealth --expect model=rwinf-3.2.6`.
ops_lead: Health gate: require <0.25% 5xx for 12m before final shift. Ops ready for handoff.
sre_oncall: Oncall monitoring +30m pre-window.
security: Exception logged; security will attach audit entry to RD-3399.
nina: All set. Any objections to 01:00 UTC start?
lee: No objections.
ops_lead: No objections.
sre_oncall: Ready.
client_eng: Customer will want status pings at canary boundaries; I'll send updates.
deploybot: Scheduled auto-start at 1748152800 (2025-09-12 01:00 UTC). This thread will receive deploybot events. Good luck :rocket:
